title: Custom Controls
tagline: Thirteen ready-to-use custom controls for abap2UI5, each a builder class with one render( ) method.
summary: A library of thirteen custom controls for abap2UI5: signature pad, Chart.js charts, barcodes, a camera scanner that reads several barcodes at once, Excel export, form validation, product tours, Font Awesome, animations, clickable image maps, Markdown, a code editor and a rich text editor. The controls ship in their own BSP Z2UI5_CCI, so nothing in abap2UI5 or its frontend has to change. Each control is used from ABAP through a builder class with one render( ) method; properties bind, values come back into ABAP variables and events arrive in the app like for any built-in control. The overview app z2ui5_cl_cci_sample_00 lists every control with its sample.
features: SignaturePad, Validator, ExportSpreadsheet, CodeEditor without external libraries
ChartJs, Barcode, DriverJs, FontAwesome, AnimateCss, Markdown wrap well-known JS libraries
BarcodeScanner reads every barcode in the picture at once, or counts identical labels
RichTextEditor (SunEditor) works on OpenUI5 too, with DOMPurify sanitizing
Branch main loads libraries from jsDelivr, branch local vendors them for offline systems
One builder class per control, one sample app per control
requirements: abap2UI5 with the reserved resourceRoot z2ui5_cci in the frontend manifest
ExportSpreadsheet needs SAPUI5 (sap.ui.export is missing under OpenUI5)
Branch main needs browser access to jsDelivr; branch local does not
BarcodeScanner needs https and 'wasm-unsafe-eval' in the CSP script-src

notes: Install with abapGit in this order: abap2UI5, then this repository
Branch main: the sources with libraries from jsDelivr (default); branch local: the same with every library vendored into the BSP, for browsers without internet access
Brings the ABAP classes, the BSP application Z2UI5_CCI and the two ICF nodes it is served from
Start ?app_start=z2ui5_cl_cci_sample_00; if it says ICF Node NOT found, activate the node z2ui5_cci in SICF
Bind configuration structures with omit_initial = abap_true and the camelCase mapper where the library expects it

usage:
z2ui5_cl_cci_rich_text_editor=>render(
    view   = page
    value  = client->_bind( mv_html )
    height = `20rem`
    change = client->_event( `TEXT_CHANGED` ) ).
